name: Iran nuclear programme
value: No IAEA access beyond Bushehr; HEU unverified
summary: IAEA has verified only at Bushehr since February and cannot account for Iran's enriched uranium, E3 and US said
state: France, Germany, the UK and the US told the IAEA Board on 18 Nov that since February the agency's only in-field verification in Iran has been at Bushehr, that it cannot conclude declared material has not been diverted, and that it has lacked continuity of knowledge of Iran's highly enriched uranium for a year and a half (UK government). The Board reported Iran's non-compliance to the UN Security Council in September. No strike on a nuclear site, NPT withdrawal or evidence of weaponisation was found to 26 Nov, so Watch holds.
for_you: The main exposure is through Gulf security and energy prices. Travellers should follow FCDO advice for Iran and the region.
rubric_hit: Inspector access curtailed (verification only at Bushehr) = Watch

sources.title: GOV.UK — Quad statement to IAEA Board of Governors, November 2026

why: A nuclear-armed Iran — or strikes to prevent one — could ignite the Gulf and send oil far higher.
drivers: Enrichment levels, IAEA access, Israeli/US military posture, snapback sanctions, talks.

rubric.alert: Strikes on nuclear sites, NPT withdrawal, or evidence of weaponisation.
rubric.watch: Enrichment at ≥ 60% or inspector access curtailed, or credible strike threats.
rubric.normal: IAEA access and active diplomacy; no escalation.
